equity.level_reason: Mistreatment and discrimination are reported by race/ethnicity and insurance and described as more common among Black, Hispanic and multiracial mothers, but values are only set side by side with no computed difference or ratio, so the level is capped at 2.

level_alternative.reason: The outcome is itself discrimination, and the discussion frames the race and insurance variation in terms of disparities and birth equity; a reader may treat the ranked prevalences as a quantified disparity.
